title: Questions to ask before buying a multi-function kitchen appliance
hook: Six questions, answered from the manufacturers' own documents, before you compare any feature list.
angle: A checklist built from the published numbers the site already holds: capacity units, wattage, dimensions, preset counts, care rules and accessory counts, with the disagreements left visible.
why_it_could_earn_traffic: Judgement: a buyer who is comparing multi-function machines needs a list of questions before a list of models. The working title came from the editorial hypotheses in the brief; it is not evidence of search demand, which this site has not measured.
